hero.description: TransKoi — powered by cutting-edge AI neural network translation technology, delivering real-time, accurate, and natural cross-language communication. Whether watching movies, making calls, or having daily conversations, you can communicate without limits.

features.title: Why Choose TransKoi?
features.subtitle: Powered by cutting-edge AI technology for an ultimate translation experience

feature1.title: 🎬 Movie Mode
feature1.description: Display real-time translated subtitles while watching foreign-language films, with a floating window design that doesn't block the screen. Supports Netflix, YouTube, and other mainstream platforms so you never miss a moment.

feature2.title: 📞 Call Translation
feature2.description: Automatically translate incoming foreign-language calls and display conversation content in real time. Supports two-way translation for seamless communication with friends abroad.
feature2.platformNote: Currently Android only. Due to iOS privacy restrictions, phone translation on iOS requires 2 devices.

feature3.title: 💬 AI Conversation Translation
feature3.description: Practice multilingual conversations with an AI assistant, supporting voice input and output. Improve your language skills and make translation more natural and fluent.

feature4.title: ⚡ Real-Time Translation
feature4.description: Neural-network-based real-time translation engine with response times under 100ms. Supports 100+ languages with industry-leading accuracy.

feature5.title: 🔒 Privacy Protection
feature5.description: All translation data is processed with local encryption and optional offline mode. Strictly compliant with GDPR privacy standards, keeping your data secure.

feature6.title: ☁️ Cloud Sync
feature6.description: Sync translation history and favorite phrases across the cloud for seamless multi-device switching. VIP users enjoy unlimited cloud storage.

products.title: Our Products

luckyPod.title: LuckyPod

download.title: Ready to Break Language Barriers?
